title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper TensorMD: Accelerating Molecular Dynamics with a High-Performance Machine Learning Interatomic Potential
motivation: Ensure reproducibility and artifact quality of SC papers
method: The reproducibility team examined the code, data, and experiment configurations that the authors submitted, checking whether their descriptions matched what was actually implemented. They then ran the experiments themselves to verify they could reproduce the same results reported in the paper.
key_novelty: This report verifies that the TensorMD paper's results can be independently reproduced using the authors' submitted code and data.
limitations: Scope limited to original paper's artifacts
